responsibility: This file provides the detailed pipeline and hazard model for N13-class NDS32 processors, also used for N12 selection in the umbrella pipeline logic. It describes the multi-stage I1/I2/E1-E4 automaton, reservation patterns for baseline, memory, DSP, and branch instructions, and bypass rules that distinguish E1- and E2-stage consumers for loads, multiword loads, and address-output dependencies, enabling the scheduler to model the deeper N13 pipeline accurately.
